parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Retrieve Revenue Resilience framework context from a transparent local P0 corpus.

OWNER
PAOLA TRACK A

INPUT CONTRACT
organization evidence plus domain/query

OUTPUT CONTRACT
rag_context with framework contexts

STATUS
Phase 2B repository-ready. Inactive by default. No credentials.

PHASE 2B P0 N8N EXECUTION
Repository-ready n8n implementation for Paola P0 only.
n8n owns the visible execution path and state passing.
21 uses an HTTP Request node against DuckDuckGo Lite HTML with no credentials.
Code nodes are limited to compact deterministic parsing, mapping, retrieval scoring, and validation.
No Python runner is called by n8n. No secrets are stored.

P0 RETRIEVAL IMPLEMENTATION
This is local JSON corpus retrieval, not Pinecone or a production vector store.
Organization evidence and framework knowledge remain separate.

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, rag_context: { ...item.json.rag_context, organization_evidence_count: (item.json.organization_evidence || []).length, framework_context_count: (item.json.rag_context?.contexts || []).length } } }));
